mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, ROUND(AVG(score), 1) AS avgScore, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_user_tour_history WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND score IS NOT NULL AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 1) FROM tb_user_tour_history WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND score IS NOT NULL AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

choose.when: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H:00') AS date, COUNT(id) AS count FROM tb_user_tour_history WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H:00') ORDER BY date ASC
